content:
ben: heads-up — a couple customers reported silent quality drops. looks like some v2 routes fell back to v1 during yesterday's quota window.
yasmin: any logs?
ben: snippet from edge:
```
[2025-06-02T14:12:05Z] req=aa11 route=acct/green variant=v2 status=THROTTLED fallback=acct/green:v1 reason=RATE_CAP decision=sticky_match -> selected=acct/green:v1
```
yasmin: hmm. sticky_match should not override explicit fallback for capacity failures. precedence bug?
oliver: i dug in — two separate issues: (1) precedence when reason==RATE_CAP, (2) upstream proxies rewriting X-Client-Variant header in some cases. they converged.
yasmin: we should emit a distinct metric for any fallback event, not just rate_cap. name idea: `route.fallback.count` with tags (route,from,to,reason=rate_cap|header_norm|sticky). low-cardinality values only.
ben: agree. sampling: full counts every 1m + sampled traces 0.5% to debug.
oliver: router fix: when reason==RATE_CAP prefer explicit `fallback_variant` over sticky. i'll drop a small PR behind flag and add unit tests.
yasmin: console: show a small "Fallbacks" column in the route table with last-1h count and a tooltip for reasons. in incident view, banner: "Some requests served by fallback variant v1 due to capacity or header parity issues." include suggested remediation.
ben: can we also tie fallback metric into quota dashboards so customers see correlation?
metrics-bot: registered metric schema: route.fallback.count -> tags: route,from,to,reason,tenant. sampling: counts 60s, sampled_traces=0.5%.
oliver: deploy-bot queued: oliver/router-fallback-precedence -> canary prod-1 at 2025-06-03T02:30:00Z.
yasmin: action items: oliver -> PR + tests (ETA: today), ben -> saved support search & customer outreach (ETA: today), yasmin -> console mock + copy (ETA: tomorrow AM), infra -> add synthetic that rewrites header variants to validate header_norm path (post-canary).
en: thanks — let's watch the canary metrics closely and abort on any spike in user-visible fallback counts.
